name: logimart-erp
description: Logimart ERP monorepo root — delegates build/start into apps/api for Railway (Nixpacks).

scripts.build: cd apps/api && npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npx prisma generate && npm run build && cd ../web && npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
scripts.start: cd apps/api && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss && node dist/main.js
